utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Hey Grandpa, how have you been?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I'm doing well, thank you! It's wonderful that you're teaching me English.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I'm glad to help, Grandpa! It's fun for me too.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: My day was quite nice. I spent some time in the garden and enjoyed the sunshine.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: That sounds lovely! I wish I could have joined you in the garden earlier.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Oh, I'm sorry if I misunderstood your question. I thought we were still catching up on my day. Let's start the lesson, shall we?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: No worries, Grandpa! I was just saying it sounded nice. We can continue with the lesson whenever.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Haha, it's good to see you laughing! I guess I got a bit ahead of myself. Let's try again when you're ready.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Sure thing, Grandpa! Let's practice some conversational phrases about your garden first.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Haha, yes, I might be getting older but I can still learn new phrases! What would you like to teach me first today?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Haha, you're never too old to learn! How about we start with some phrases you can use on your phone?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: That's a good idea. My day was nice, but using the phone can be a struggle. I enjoyed the sunshine today, though.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: I'm glad you enjoyed it. So, about those English phrases for the phone, are you ready to become an expert?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I certainly am! It's so nice to have these chats with you while I learn.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: It's great chatting with you too, Grandpa! So, are you ready to dive into some more English?
